Title: 2026 Comprehensive Health, Sleep Quality & Lifestyle Study

Brief.research_goal: Investigate correlations between sleep duration, exercise frequency, stress, and systolic blood pressure.
Brief.target_audience: Adult demographic participants across varying physical activity levels.
hypotheses: Increased daily sleep hours correlates with lower systolic blood pressure.
Higher stress levels correlate with reduced physical energy.
Exercise frequency significantly impacts overall mental well-being.
